headline: Cornerstone Insurance 9M Pre-Tax Profit Falls 6.93% to N7.74 Billion
summary: Cornerstone Insurance Plc reported an unaudited pre-tax profit of N7.74 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, marking a 6.93% decline compared to N8.32 billion in the same period of 2025.
why: Quarterly earnings reports provide baseline financial health metrics for publicly listed insurers, allowing investors to assess underwriting profitability and investment income trends.

impacts.name: Cornerstone Insurance Plc
impacts.why: A lower pre-tax profit reflects weaker financial performance for the insurance firm.
